quote: Buspirone hydrochloride tablets, USP are indicated for the management of anxiety disorders or the short-term relief of the symptoms of anxiety.
note: Anxiety disorders are named directly as the condition managed.

quote: reducing neurologic disability and/or the frequency of clinical relapses in patients with secondary (chronic) progressive, progressive relapsing, or worsening relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis
note: Several MS subtypes are indicated (the primary-progressive negation covers only one subtype), so the parent edge 'multiple sclerosis' is a target.

quote: Tivicay is indicated in combination with other anti-retroviral medicinal products for the treatment of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) infected adults, adolescents and children
note: EMA text indicates treatment of HIV infection; combination antiretroviral therapy still counts.

quote: indicated for the treatment of documented ventricular arrhythmias, such as sustained ventricular tachycardia, that in the judgment of the physician are life-threatening.
note: Life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias are the named treatment target; the edge is a near-exact match.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult and paediatric patients 12 years of age and older with solid tumours expressing a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion
note: EMA indication names NTRK gene-fusion solid tumours, an exact synonym of the edge disease.

quote: monotherapy for the maintenance treatment of adult patients with germline BRCA1/2-mutations who have metastatic adenocarcinoma of the pancreas
note: Metastatic BRCA-mutated pancreatic adenocarcinoma is a more specific form of pancreatic adenocarcinoma, so the edge is a target.

quote: RENOVA (tretinoin cream) 0.02% has NOT DEMONSTRATED A MITIGATING EFFECT on significant signs of chronic sunlight exposure such as coarse or deep wrinkling, tactile roughness, mottled hyperpigmentation
note: Dyschromatosis universalis hereditaria is not mentioned anywhere; the only pigmentation references are photoaging-related hyperpigmentation that the label says is not mitigated and melasma on a combination product, neither of which is this hereditary disorder.

quote: Terazosin capsules, USP are indicated for the treatment of symptomatic benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH).
note: BPH is named directly as the treated condition.

quote: Ezmekly as monotherapy is indicated for the treatment of symptomatic, inoperable plexiform neurofibromas (PN) in paediatric and adult patients with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1)
note: The treated target is plexiform neurofibromas; NF1 appears only as the patient population in which they occur.

quote: including diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) not otherwise specified, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, high grade B-cell lymphoma
note: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma is explicitly listed among the indicated large B-cell lymphomas in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Kinpeygo is indicated for the treatment of adults with primary immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN) with a urine protein excretion ≥1.0 g/day
note: IgA nephropathy is the standard synonym of IgA glomerulonephritis and is an indication on the EMA single-ingredient budesonide product.

quote: Ilaris is indicated for the treatment of active Still’s disease including adult-onset Still’s disease (AOSD) and systemic juvenile idiopathic arthritis (SJIA)
note: Adult-onset Still's disease is named explicitly as an indication.

quote: fulminating or disseminated pulmonary tuberculosis when used concurrently with appropriate antituberculous chemotherapy; asthma
note: Asthma is a named item in the list of indicated respiratory and allergic conditions.

quote: Adult patients with relapsed or refractory Philadelphia chromosome positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ ALL).
note: Ph+ ALL is a more specific form of acute lymphoblastic leukemia, so the edge is a target under the subtype rule.

quote: Topotecan is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic carcinoma of the ovary after failure of first-line or subsequent therapy.
note: Metastatic carcinoma of the ovary is an exact synonym of the edge disease.

quote: Vardenafil hydrochloride tablets are indicated for the treatment of erectile dysfunction.
note: Erectile dysfunction is named directly as the treated condition in FDA and EMA text.

quote: Lyrica is indicated for the treatment of peripheral and central neuropathic pain in adults.
note: Peripheral and central neuropathic pain together constitute neuropathic pain, which is named as the treatment target.

quote: In disorders requiring parenteral administration of vitamins, i.e. pre- and post-operative treatment, when requirements are increased as in fever, severe burns, increased metabolism
note: Fever is cited only as a circumstance that raises vitamin requirements; the product supplies vitamins and does not treat febrile disorders.

quote: Effentora is indicated for the treatment of breakthrough pain (BTP) in adults with cancer who are already receiving maintenance opioid therapy for chronic cancer pain.
note: Breakthrough pain is named directly as the treated condition.

quote: Perennial and seasonal allergic rhinitis Vasomotor rhinitis Allergic conjunctivitis due to inhalant allergens and foods
note: Atopic conjunctivitis is a form of allergic conjunctivitis, which is a named indication.

quote: Uses treats migraine
note: The OTC acetaminophen label text states the product treats migraine; the text is terse but names the disease as the treatment target.

quote: CONTEPO is indicated for the treatment of patients 18 years and older with complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including acute pyelonephritis
note: Complicated urinary tract infection is named directly as an indication on the CONTEPO label.

quote: indicated for the management of hypoglycemia due to hyperinsulinism associated with the following conditions
note: The treated condition is hypoglycemia; islet cell adenoma/carcinoma is the underlying cause and setting, not what diazoxide treats.
Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text; the indications are Parkinson's disease and parkinsonism only.

quote: treatment of adults with unresectable or metastatic gastric, esophageal, or gastroesophageal junction cancer as a component of a combination chemotherapy regimen.
note: Esophageal cancer is named explicitly as an indication.

quote: indicated for the relief of the inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid responsive dermatoses in patients 12 years of age or older
note: Atopic dermatitis is a corticosteroid-responsive dermatosis (a subtype of the indicated class), and the label's own clinical data describe use in adult and pediatric atopic dermatitis patients.

quote: indicated for the treatment of acute manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar disorder, with or without psychotic features.
note: Treating the manic and mixed episodes of bipolar disorder is management of the disease itself, so bipolar disorder is the target.

quote: Treatment of Wilson's disease.
note: EMA text names Wilson's disease directly as the indication.

quote: patients with renal artery stenosis, chronic kidney disease, severe congestive heart failure, or volume depletion) may be at particular risk of developing acute renal failure
note: Olmesartan is indicated only for hypertension; congestive heart failure appears as an at-risk population in warnings and as a generic remark about other antihypertensives, never as an indication.

quote: maintenance bronchodilator treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.
note: Maintenance bronchodilator treatment of COPD airflow obstruction is management of COPD itself, on the single-ingredient label.

quote: Rolufta is indicated as a maintenance bronchodilator treatment to relieve symptoms in adult patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
note: COPD is the indicated condition on the EMA umeclidinium products, including the single-agent bronchodilator.
ADHD is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text; thyroid tablets are indicated for hypothyroidism, euthyroid goiters and thyroid cancer only.

quote: indicated for the treatment of generalized tonic-clonic (grand mal) and complex partial (psychomotor, temporal lobe) seizures
note: Treatment of complex partial seizures is treatment of complex partial epilepsy.

quote: Uses For temporary relief of temporary water retention bloat swelling full feeling fatigue minor aches and pains associated with the premenstrual and menstrual periods.
note: An OTC label in the union lists fatigue among the symptoms the product relieves; the text does not allow attribution to a partner ingredient, so it is judged a target from the text as supplied.

quote: Imipenem and Cilastatin for Injection, USP (I.V.) for intravenous use is indicated for the treatment of lower respiratory tract infections caused by susceptible strains of Staphylococcus aureus
note: Recurrent LRTI is a narrower form of the indicated lower respiratory tract infections, and the label attributes antibacterial activity to imipenem (cilastatin is only a dehydropeptidase inhibitor).

quote: For the management of primary dysmenorrhea
note: Primary dysmenorrhea is a more specific form of dysmenorrhea and is a named indication.

quote: POTELIGEO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mycosis fungoides (MF) or Sézary syndrome (SS) after at least one prior systemic therapy.
note: Sézary syndrome is named directly as an indication in FDA and EMA text.
